item.title: ‘If Illegal Investigation Occurs, Court May Dismiss Indictment’ — Sneaked into Bill Abolishing Supplementary Investigations (‘위법 수사땐 법원이 공소 기각’ 보완수사 폐지법에 끼워 넣어)
item.description:
‘If Illegal Investigation Occurs, Court May Dismiss Indictment’ — Sneaked into Bill Abolishing Supplementary Investigations (‘위법 수사땐 법원이 공소 기각’ 보완수사 폐지법에 끼워 넣어)

It was confirmed on the 29th that the Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) belatedly added ‘grounds for court dismissal of indictment’ to a revision of the Criminal Procedure Act aimed at completely abolishing the prosecution’s supplementary investigation authority. During a late-night closed-door bill review the previous day, the Ministry of Justice and the Supreme Prosecutors’ Office expressed opposition, but the DPK pushed it through without agreement from the opposition party. The People Power Party (PPP) called it “President Lee Jae-myung’s trial-erasure law,” saying, “When it became difficult to introduce a special counsel for indictment cancellation, they created a detour to allow the court to dismiss the indictment.” However, the DPK held a plenary session of the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee on that day and forcibly passed the revision to the Criminal Procedure Act. <<> The DPK and other pro-government lawmakers reportedly passed the revision to the Criminal Procedure Act during a late-night subcommittee meeting on the 28th, with PPP lawmakers absent, by adding provisions expanding the grounds for dismissal of indictment, which had not been previously discussed. Dismissal of indictment is a procedure that terminates a case without ruling on guilt or innocence when there is a serious defect in the filing of the indictment. Under the current Criminal Procedure Act, dismissal is allowed only when the indictment process violates legal regulations or when it is determined that the court lacks jurisdiction over the defendant. <<> However, the revision adds two new grounds: ‘when an indictment is filed based on a serious illegal investigation’ and ‘when an indictment is filed through a significant deviation from prosecutorial discretion.’ This provides legal grounds for a defendant to argue that “the prosecution conducted a targeted or illegal investigation” and, if the court accepts it, to halt the trial. Despite the Ministry of Justice opposing the revision, citing “concerns over serious side effects,” the DPK forced the amendment through. <<> The DPK also forcibly passed the ‘Fast-Track Deadline Reduction Act’ on the same day. This aims to shorten the current fast-track review period, which takes up to 330 days (180 days in standing committees, 90 days in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and 60 days in the plenary session), to 60 days in standing committees, 30 days in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and submission to the first plenary session after referral. <<> ◇If Indictment Cannot Be Cancelled via Special Counsel, Court Dismisses It… A Dual Device to ‘Save Lee’ <<> Regarding the DPK’s addition of grounds for dismissal of indictment to the Criminal Procedure Act revision, opposition party and legal circles pointed out, “The DPK, after attempting to cancel the indictment in the president’s case by pushing a ‘special counsel for manipulated indictments,’ found the circumstances unfavorable, so they are now creating a ‘detour’ to halt trials through court dismissal of indictment.” <<> The current Article 327 of the Criminal Procedure Act allows dismissal of indictment only under six conditions, such as ‘when there is no jurisdiction over the defendant,’ ‘when the indictment procedure violates legal regulations and is invalid,’ and ‘when a complaint is withdrawn.’ A lawyer and former chief judge said, “The law’s intent is to restrict conditions to a minimum, as it is a serious decision to halt the verdict itself without judging guilt or innocence.” <<> However, the revision adds two new grounds: ‘serious illegal investigation’ and ‘deviation from discretion.’ Additionally, it includes a provision on the prosecutor’s duty of objectivity, stating, “Prosecutors must maintain objectivity and neutrality in the process of filing and maintaining indictments and take necessary measures for the interests of suspects and defendants.” <<> Legal circles expressed concerns that “with the strengthened prosecutor duty clause and the addition of vague and subjective grounds like ‘illegal investigation’ or ‘deviation from prosecutorial authority,’ the court might accept a defendant’s arbitrary claims and terminate the trial.” PPP Judiciary Committee lawmaker Joo Jin-woo said on Facebook that day, “This is an attempt to erase the criminal trial of the president through legislative power.” Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon also said, “In cases like the North Korean remittance case, where (President Lee’s) innocence seems impossible and indictment cancellation is difficult, they aim to pressure the court to issue a dismissal of indictment verdict. Indictment cancellation is Plan A, constitutional amendment for re-election is Plan B, and dismissal of indictment is Plan C.” <<> During the full committee meeting of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee that day, PPP lawmakers opposed the complete abolition of supplementary investigation authority, arguing, “We need sufficient discussion to protect victims and prevent investigative gaps,” but Committee Chairman Seo Young-kyo of the DKP pushed for a vote. The DKP plans to submit the revision to the National Assembly’s plenary session on the 30th. If the PPP conducts a filibuster, they intend to forcibly terminate it after 24 hours and process it on the 31st. This means processing it in a ‘cramming’ style less than a week after adopting the abolition of supplementary investigation as party policy at a general meeting of lawmakers on the 24th. <<> The DKP stated, “Instead of ‘completely abolishing’ the prosecution’s investigation authority (in the Criminal Procedure Act), we have sufficiently prepared supplementary measures, such as enhancing the effectiveness of requests for supplementary investigations.” However, many legal professionals expressed doubts about the effectiveness of the right to request supplementary investigations, worrying, “The problems of case burial and investigative delays will become more serious.” <<> The revision adds a prosecutor’s ‘management responsibility’ to track the implementation of supplementary investigations, such as maintaining the case number in the Criminal Justice Information System (KICS) when a prosecutor requests one. A chief prosecutor in the Seoul metropolitan area said, “They’ve stripped us of investigative authority, leaving us unable to do anything, but now they only want to hold us accountable for cases where we’ve requested supplementary investigations.” <<> A new ‘fact-finding’ procedure for prosecutors has also been created, allowing them to interview suspects, case-related individuals, experts, and judicial police officers, or receive materials, as needed before deciding on indictment filing or maintenance, or requesting reinvestigation. However, statements and materials obtained through fact-finding are not recognized as evidence, leading to criticism that “it holds little effectiveness and could cause confusion in trials regarding evidentiary capacity.” <<> The initial revision proposed by the DKP granted police the authority to arrest and detain suspects for 48 hours without prosecutor oversight. However, after repeated concerns about ‘excessive investigations’ by the police, the relevant provisions were removed from the final version. <<> Legal circles and the opposition party unanimously criticized the abolition of the prosecution’s supplementary investigation authority. Acting Prosecutor General Gu Ja-hyun issued a statement that day, saying, “If the prosecutor’s effective functions of checking, supplementing, and correcting disappear, the truth will be concealed, and the Republic of Korea’s criminal justice system will collapse. The victims will be the people, who need the state’s protection more than anyone else.” (더불어민주당이 검찰의 보완수사권 전면 폐지를 골자로 하는 형사소송법 개정안에 뒤늦게 ‘법원의 공소기각 사유’를 추가한 것으로 29일 확인됐다. 전날 밤 비공개 법안 심사 과정에서 법무부와 대검찰청이 반대 의견을 냈지만 야당과 합의 없이 밀어붙인 것이다. 국민의힘은 “이재명 대통령의 재판 지우기법”이라며 “공소취소 특검 도입이 어려워진다 싶으니까 이번에는 법원이 공소를 기각하도록 우회로를 만든 것”이라고 했다. 하지만 민주당은 이날 국회 법제사법위원회 전체회의를 열고 형소법 개정안을 강행 처리했다.)

item.title: Amid Backlash from Ruling Bloc… New US Ambassador to Korea Assumes Post (여권 일부 반발 속에… 부임하는 주한美대사)
item.description:
Amid Backlash from Ruling Bloc… New US Ambassador to Korea Assumes Post (여권 일부 반발 속에… 부임하는 주한美대사)

Michelle Steel (Korean name: Park Eun-ju), the first female Korean-American US ambassador to South Korea, arrives in Seoul on the 30th. Ambassador Steel is the first ambassador to South Korea under the second Trump administration, filling a vacancy that lasted about a year and a half since former Ambassador Philip Goldberg departed. During that time, the US Embassy in Seoul operated under a chargé d'affaires system with Joseph Yun, Kevin Kim, and James Heller. (한국계 첫 여성 주한미국대사인 미셸 스틸(한국명 박은주)이 30일 서울에 부임한다. 스틸 대사는 트럼프 2기의 첫 주한대사로, 필립 골드버그 전 대사 이임 후 약 1년 반 만에 주한미대사 공백 사태가 해소됐다. 그동안 주한미대사관은 조셉 윤, 케빈 김, 제임스 헬러 대사대리 체제로 운영돼 왔다.)

Ambassador Steel, the daughter of a displaced person and the second Korean-American ambassador to South Korea born in Seoul in 1955, is not receiving a ‘blessing’ from the ruling bloc, including the Democratic Party. This contrasts sharply with the atmosphere when Sung Kim was appointed as the first Korean-American US ambassador to South Korea. (스틸 대사는 실향민의 딸로 1955년 서울에서 태어난 두번째 한국계 주한미대사지만, 민주당을 비롯한 여권의 ‘블레싱(축복)’을 받지 못하고 있다. 성 김이 한국계 미국인으로는 최초로 주한미대사에 임명됐을 때와는 사뭇 다른 분위기다.)

The left-wing camp is opposing Steel, citing her past hardline stance on North Korea and China issues and her tendency to engage primarily with conservative figures in South Korea. (좌파 진영은 스틸 대사가 그동안 북한, 중국 문제에 대해 강경한 입장을 보였으며 주로 한국의 보수적인 인사들과 교류해왔다며 반발하고 있다.)

In response, the US side has reinforced its security team and requested protection from South Korean police, preparing for possible protests at Incheon Airport where Ambassador Steel will arrive. The embassy is also cautious about issuing a statement regarding Steel's arrival. (이에 따라 미국 측은 스틸 대사가 입국하는 인천공항에 반대 시위가 있을 가능성 등에 대비, 자체 경호팀을 보강하고 한국 경찰에도 경호 요청을 했다. 대사관측도 스틸 대사의 입국 성명 발표 등에 대해 신중한 모습을 보이고 있다.)

South Korea's left-wing camp has been continuously campaigning against Steel since she was nominated as ambassador in April. Shortly after the White House's announcement, left-wing groups held a rally in front of the US Embassy in Seoul and issued a joint statement titled "Withdraw the Nomination of Michelle Steel as US Ambassador to South Korea, Who Turns the Korean Peninsula into a Battlefield of Confrontation and Leads Trump's Exploitative Policies." They claimed over 400 organizations participated. During a May ‘Candlelight March for Ending the Insurrection’ rally, there were claims that "Michelle Steel is not the US ambassador to South Korea but an ambassador to the far-right in South Korea, coming to attack the Lee Jae-myung government and command domestic far-right forces." (한국의 좌파 진영은 스틸이 지난 4월 대사에 지명됐을 때 부터 지속적으로 반대 운동을 벌이고 있다. 좌파단체들은 백악관 발표 직후 주한미대사관 앞에서 집회를 갖고 “한반도를 대결의 전장으로 만들고 트럼프의 수탈 정책 선봉에 선 미셸 스틸의 주한미대사 지명 철회하라”는 제목의 공동 성명을 발표했다. 400여 단체가 이에 동참했다고 밝히기도 했다. 지난 5월 ‘내란청산 촛불 대행진’ 집회에서는 “미셸 스틸은 주한미대사가 아니라 주한극우대사로 이재명 정부를 공격하며 국내 극우세력을 지휘하러 오는 자”라는 주장이 나오기도 했다.)

◇First Female Korean-American US Ambassador to South Korea… Ruling Bloc Labels Her “Far-Right Hardliner” (◇한국계 여성 첫 주한 美 대사… 여권선 “극우·강경파” 날세워)

Song Young-gil, a former leader of the Democratic Party of Korea and a candidate for the next foreign minister, is at the forefront of this negative stance. Last month, even after Steel was confirmed by the US Senate, Song mentioned former Deputy Secretary of State Steve Biegun, who was involved in US-North Korea summit talks, saying, "It is a great pity that someone like him didn't come as the US ambassador to South Korea." He also added, "Going forward, rather than repeating controversies after appointment, we need to exert influence to recommend trusted figures in advance through bilateral consultation." (더불어민주당 대표를 지내고, 차기 외교부 장관으로도 거론되는 송영길 의원은 이같은 부정적인 입장의 선두에 서 있다. 송 의원은 지난달 스틸 대사가 미 상원에서 인준됐음에도 미북 정상회담에 관여했던 스티브 비건 전 국무부 부장관을 거론하며 “이런 분이 주한 미국대사로 왔더라면 하는 아쉬움이 크다”고 했다. 또, “앞으로는 (주한미대사) 임명 이후 논란을 반복하기보다 사전에 양국이 신뢰할 수 있는 인물을 추천할 수 있는 영향력을 발휘할 필요가 있다”고 했다.)

The sentiment of displeasure toward Steel extends beyond the Democratic Party to the Rebuilding Korea Party, which is being considered for a possible merger with the Democratic Party. Kim Jun-hyung, floor leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party, last year mentioned Steel as one of the ‘five anti-Korea figures’ during the personnel hearing for Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul. In a media interview, he suggested caution regarding the agrément, claiming she was linked to far-right forces in South Korea. (스틸 대사를 탐탁지 않게 여기는 분위기는 민주당뿐만 아니라 합당 가능성이 거론되는 조국혁신당에도 퍼져 있다. 조국혁신당의 김준형 원내대표는 지난해 조현 외교부 장관 인사 청문회에서 스틸을 ‘반한(反韓) 5적’ 중 한 명으로 거론했다. 또 언론 인터뷰에서 그가 한국의 극우 세력과 연관돼 있다며 아그레망 신중론을 폈다.)

It is known that the White House and US State Department are closely monitoring these moves by the ruling bloc and have conveyed concerns to the South Korean government. They worry that moves to reject an ambassador appointed by President Trump with full powers could negatively impact the US-South Korea alliance. (미 백악관과 국무부는 여권의 이같은 움직임을 예의주시하며 우리 정부에 우려를 전한 것으로 알려졌다. 트럼프 대통령이 임명한 특명전권대사 거부 움직임이 한미관계에 부정적인 영향을 미칠 수 있다는 것이다.)

The US side views that Steel merely holds principled stances that North Korea and China should not threaten neighboring countries and should respect the human rights of North Korean residents, while South Korea's left-wing camp is labeling her ‘far-right’ and ‘hardline.’ In May 2022, as a US House Representative, Steel co-signed a letter with Rep. Young Kim to the Secretaries of State and Defense following the launch of the Yoon Suk Yeol government, pointing out that "Kim Jong-un has no interest in a declaration to end the war and is focused on improving the ability to fire nuclear warheads or short-range conventional warheads at military bases in South Korea, Japan, and the US." The letter also stated that "cooperating with the South Korean administration to strengthen US deterrence in Northeast Asia is critical to prevent further escalation of tensions by North Korea." Additionally, it urged the Chinese government to stop forced repatriation of North Korean defectors, noting that "North Korea and the Chinese Communist Party are actively tracking defectors." A source close to Steel said, "Upon taking office, Ambassador Steel will seek to clear up misunderstandings about her and express her intention to further strengthen the US-South Korea relationship at this critical time." (미국 측은 스틸 대사가 북한과 중국이 주변국을 위협하지 말아야 하며 북한 주민의 인권을 중시해야 한다는 원칙적인 입장을 갖고 있을 뿐인데, 한국의 좌파 진영이 ‘극우’ ‘강경파’ 딱지를 붙이고 있다고 보고 있다. 스틸 대사는 연방하원의원 시절인 2022년 5월 윤석열 정부 출범에 맞춰 영 김 의원과 함께 국무·국방 장관에게 보낸 서한에서 “김정은이 종전 선언에 관심이 없으며 한국과 일본, 미국 군사 기지에 대해 핵탄두 또는 단거리 재래식 탄두를 발사할 수 있는 능력 향상에 집중하고 있다”고 지적했다. 또 “북한의 추가적인 긴장 고조를 막기 위해 동북아에서 미국의 억지력을 강화하는 데 한국 행정부와 협력하는 것이 매우 중요하다”고 했다. 이 서한은 또 “북한과 중국 공산당이 탈북민을 적극적으로 추적하고 있다”며 중국 정부의 탈북민 강제 북송 중단을 촉구했다. 스틸 대사와 가까운 관계자는 “스틸 대사가 부임하면 자신에 대한 오해를 풀고, 중요한 시기에 한미 관계를 더욱 강하게 만들겠다는 입장을 밝힐 것”이라고 했다.)

Diplomatic circles are concerned about a repeat of the conflict seen during the tenure of former US Ambassador to South Korea Harry Harris. At that time, the left-wing camp attacked Harris, who is of Japanese descent, over his North Korea policy and even likened his mustache to that of Japanese colonial-era governors-general of Korea. Harris also reacted emotionally on some issues, leading to a strained relationship between the two sides. (외교가에서는 과거 해리 해리스 전 주한 미국 대사 때와 같은 갈등이 재연되지 않을까 우려하고 있다. 당시 좌파 진영은 일본계인 해리스 대사의 대북 정책을 공격하며 그의 콧수염이 일제 시대 조선 총독을 연상시킨다고도 했다. 해리스 대사 역시 일부 사안에서 감정적으로 대응하면서 양측의 관계는 원만하지 못했다.)

Ambassador Steel is a former US House Representative, first elected in 2020 for California's 48th congressional district and re-elected in 2022. In Congress, she consistently voiced support for North Korean human rights, containing China, and the US-South Korea alliance. Her husband, Sean Steel, is a prominent figure who served as the California state representative for the Republican National Committee (RNC) and played a key role in organizational expansion and fundraising for Trump's presidential campaign. He is frequently invited to major White House events hosted by President Trump and is known to have influenced Steel's appointment as ambassador. Trump described Steel as a "‘America First patriot’ whose parents bravely escaped communism," and she is also seen as a politician who can immediately call the White House in times of crisis. (스틸 대사는 2020년 캘리포니아주 제48선거구에서 연방하원의원에 당선된 데 이어 2022년 재선에 성공한 연방하원의원 출신이다. 연방의회에서는 북한 인권, 중국 견제, 한미동맹에 대해 꾸준히 목소리를 내왔다. 남편 숀 스틸은 공화당 전국위원회(RNC) 캘리포니아주 대표를 지낸 유력 인사로 트럼프 대통령의 대선 캠프에서 조직 확장, 정치자금 모금에서 핵심적인 역할을 했다. 트럼프 대통령이 백악관에서 개최하는 주요 행사에 자주 초청하는 인물로 스틸이 대사가 되는데 영향을 미친 것으로 알려졌다. 트럼프는 스틸 대사에 대해 “(부모가) 공산주의를 피해 용감하게 탈출한 ‘미국 우선주의 애국자”라고 했는데, 유사시 즉각 백악관에 전화해 통화할 수 있는 정치인이라는 평가도 나온다.)

A former high-ranking foreign ministry official, speaking on condition of anonymity, said, "Currently, many issues are piling up between South Korea and the US, such as the Coupang problem, the transfer of wartime operational control, revision of the nuclear agreement, and trade and tariff negotiations." He added, "Ambassador Steel should actively work to clear up misunderstandings about herself, and the ruling bloc should also refrain from excessive ideological attacks." (익명을 요구한 전직 외교부 고위 관계자는 “지금은 한미 양국 간에 쿠팡 문제, 전시작전통제권 전환, 원자력 협정 개정, 통상·관세 협상 등 현안이 산적해 있는 상황”이라며 “스틸 대사가 적극적으로 자신에 대한 오해를 해소하려는 노력을 기울이고, 여권도 과도한 이념 공세를 자제해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee arrives in Santiago, Chile... Summit with President Kast on the 30th (李대통령, 칠레 산티아고 도착...30일 카스트 대통령과 정상회담)
item.description:
President Lee arrives in Santiago, Chile... Summit with President Kast on the 30th (李대통령, 칠레 산티아고 도착...30일 카스트 대통령과 정상회담)

President Lee Jae-myung, currently touring the United States and South America, arrived in Santiago, the capital of Chile, his second stop, on the 29th (local time) after completing his state visit to Brazil, beginning a two-day official visit schedule. (미국과 남미를 순방 중인 이재명 대통령이 29일(현지 시각) 브라질 국빈 방문 일정을 마치고 두 번째 방문지인 칠레의 수도 산티아고에 도착해 1박 2일 동안의 공식 방문 일정을 시작했다.)

The President will hold a dinner meeting with local compatriots on the afternoon of the same day. On the 30th, he is scheduled to hold a summit with Chilean President José Antonio Kast, who took office in March. Following an official welcome ceremony and gift exchange at the Chilean Presidential Palace, the summit will take place, followed by a memorandum of understanding (MOU) signing ceremony, joint press conference, and official lunch. (이 대통령은 이날 오후 현지 동포들과 만찬 간담회를 갖는다. 30일에는 지난 3월 취임한 호세 안토니오 카스트 칠레 대통령과 정상회담을 가질 예정이다. 칠레 대통령궁에서 공식 환영식과 선물 교환식에 이어 정상회담을 갖고, 양해각서(MOU) 서명식과 공동 언론 발표, 공식 오찬이 이어진다.)

Regarding the main agenda of this summit, Cheong Wa Dae National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac said in a briefing on the 22nd of last month, "We will discuss the 'modernization of the FTA' with Chile, our first FTA partner." This means that, as the Korea-Chile FTA, which took effect in 2004, is now over 20 years old, discussions will be held on adjusting the FTA to fit current circumstances. A Cheong Wa Dae official stated, "As both countries have areas they wish to further open, there are elements to modernize in line with the latest FTA trends, and negotiations are underway." (이번 정상회담의 주요 의제와 관련해, 위성락 청와대 국가안보실장은 지난달 22일 브리핑에서 “우리의 첫 FTA 체결국인 칠레와 ‘FTA 현대화’를 논의하게 된다”고 했다. 지난 2004년 발효된 한·칠레 FTA가 20년이 넘은 만큼, FTA를 최근 상황에 맞게 조정하는 작업을 논의하게 된다는 얘기다. 청와대 측은 “양국이 서로 추가 개방을 원하는 것이 있기 때문에 최신 FTA 트렌드에 맞게 현대화할 요소가 있고 협상을 진행 중”이라고 했다.)

Discussions are also expected regarding key mineral supply chains with Chile, a resource-rich country. Chile holds the world's largest reserves of copper and lithium. (자원 부국인 칠레와 핵심 광물 공급망 관련 논의도 이뤄질 전망이다. 칠레는 구리와 리튬 매장량이 세계 1위다.)

Before the summit, President Lee will lay a wreath at the statue of Bernardo O'Higgins, Chile's founding hero. O'Higgins is a figure revered as the father of the nation by the Chilean people for leading the country's war of independence to victory in the early 19th century. (이 대통령은 정상회담 전, 칠레의 건국 영웅 베르나르도 오이긴스 동상에 헌화한다. 오이긴스는 19세기 초 칠레의 독립 전쟁을 승리로 이끌어 칠레 국민들에게 국부로 추앙받는 인물이다.)

Following the summit, the President will attend the "Korea-Chile Business Roundtable" event with business leaders from both countries, and is scheduled to depart on the evening of the 31st for Buenos Aires, Argentina, the final stop of his South American tour. (이 대통령은 정상회담 뒤 양국 기업인이 참석하는 ‘한·칠레 비즈니스 라운드테이블’ 행사에도 참석한 뒤 31일 저녁 남미 순방의 마지막 방문국인 아르헨티나 부에노스아이레스로 이동할 예정이다.)

item.title: China's Wang Yi to Visit South Korea on August 19-20, Likely to Discuss North Korea Nuclear and Taiwan Issues (中 왕이, 8월 19~20일 방한 예정… 북핵·대만 문제 논의할 듯)
item.description:
China's Wang Yi to Visit South Korea on August 19-20, Likely to Discuss North Korea Nuclear and Taiwan Issues (中 왕이, 8월 19~20일 방한 예정… 북핵·대만 문제 논의할 듯)

Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi is expected to visit South Korea from August 19 for a two-day trip, with the two countries reportedly in final coordination on the schedule. Minister Wang will hold talks with Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul, likely discussing bilateral issues, as well as North Korea-related and regional and global matters. This would mark Wang Yi's first visit to South Korea for a bilateral foreign ministers' meeting since September 2021, after about five years. (왕이 중국 외교부장(장관)이 다음 달 19일부터 1박 2일 일정으로 방한하는 방안을 한중 양국이 최종 조율 중인 것으로 알려졌다. 왕 부장은 조현 외교부 장관과 회담을 갖고 양국 현안과 북한 및 역내·세계 문제를 논의할 것으로 보인다. 왕 부장이 한중 외교장관 회담을 위해 방한하는 것은 2021년 9월 이후 약 5년 만이다.)

According to a diplomatic source on the 29th, the upcoming talks are expected to cover a wide range of key issues, including follow-up measures from the South Korea-China summit in January and the situation on the Korean Peninsula. Attention is particularly focused on how North Korea's denuclearization will be addressed. Wang Yi's visit to South Korea was previously pushed for the first quarter of this year but did not materialize, and Wang visited North Korea in April. Chinese President Xi Jinping also visited North Korea on the 8th of last month and held talks with Chairman Kim Jong-un, but made no mention of "the denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula," leading to interpretations that China is essentially tolerating North Korea's nuclear program. (29일 외교 소식통에 따르면, 이번 회담에서는 지난 1월 한중 정상회담의 후속 조치와 한반도 정세 등 주요 현안이 폭넓게 논의될 전망이다. 특히 북한의 비핵화 문제가 어떻게 다뤄질지 주목된다. 왕 부장 방한은 올 1분기에도 추진됐지만 성사되지 않았고, 왕 부장은 지난 4월 북한을 방문했다. 시진핑 주석도 지난달 8일 북한을 방문해 김정은 국무위원장과 회담했는데 ‘한반도 비핵화’에 대한 언급이 없어, 중국이 사실상 북핵을 용인하는 것이란 해석이 나왔다.)

In response, the South Korean government is said to have conveyed to China its position, through channels including the director-general-level consultations between the two foreign ministries, that it is undesirable for the narrative of China "turning a blind eye to North Korea's nuclear ambitions" to continue spreading, as it does not contribute to peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula. In this meeting, Minister Cho is expected to reiterate the stance that China should play a more constructive role in the denuclearization and peace and stability of the Korean Peninsula. (이에 우리 정부는 한중 외교부 국장급 협의 등을 계기로 중국의 ‘북핵 묵인설’이 계속 확산하는 것은 바람직하지 않고, 한반도 평화·안정에도 도움이 되지 않는다는 입장을 전한 것으로 알려졌다. 이번 회담에서도 조 장관은 중국이 한반도 비핵화와 평화·안정을 위해 보다 건설적인 역할을 해달라는 입장을 전달할 것으로 보인다.)

Minister Wang, who has emphasized the "One China" principle, is expected to raise the Taiwan issue. Other topics likely to be addressed in the talks include China's installation of structures within the Provisional Measures Zone (PMZ) in the West Sea, the demarcation of the maritime boundary between South Korea and China, and illegal fishing by Chinese fishing vessels. After President Yoon Suk Yeol's state visit to China in January, China moved one of its three large steel structures outside the PMZ, but the remaining two are still located within the zone. Additionally, follow-up discussions on the panda donation requested by President Yoon from President Xi during his China visit are expected to continue. (‘하나의 중국’ 원칙을 강조해 온 왕 부장은 대만 문제를 제기할 것으로 예상된다. 중국의 서해 잠정조치수역(PMZ) 내 구조물 설치 문제, 한·중 해상 경계 획정, 중국 어선의 불법 조업 등의 현안도 이번 회담에서 다뤄질 전망이다. 중국 측은 지난 1월 이재명 대통령의 국빈 방중 이후 대형 철제 구조물 3기 중 1기를 PMZ 밖으로 이동시켰지만, 나머지 2기는 여전히 PMZ 내에 두고 있다. 그 밖에 이 대통령이 방중 시 시 주석에게 요청한 판다 기증 관련 후속 협의도 이번에 이어질 것으로 보인다.)

Minister Wang may also pay a courtesy call on President Yoon during his visit to South Korea. He is expected to request President Yoon's attendance and cooperation at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit to be held in Shenzhen, China, in November this year. Wang Yi is also reportedly coordinating a separate meeting with Unification Minister Kim Yung-ho. (왕 부장이 방한 기간 이 대통령을 예방할 가능성도 있다. 중국이 올 11월 선전(深圳)에서 개최하는 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의에 이 대통령의 참석과 협조를 당부할 것으로 예상된다. 왕 부장은 정동영 통일부 장관과의 별도 면담도 조율 중인 것으로 전해졌다.)

item.title: Frontline K4 Grenade Launcher Also ‘Unloaded for Guard Duty’ (최전방 K4 유탄기관총도 ‘빈총 경계’)
item.description:
Frontline K4 Grenade Launcher Also ‘Unloaded for Guard Duty’ (최전방 K4 유탄기관총도 ‘빈총 경계’)

It was confirmed on the 29th that the Army’s 1st Corps, which plays a key role in defending the western front, has issued a directive not to load live ammunition into the K4 high-speed grenade launcher during guard duty at forward Guard Posts (GP) and General Outposts (GOP). The K4 high-speed grenade launcher has the greatest firepower among the weapons used by infantry in the front-line area and is considered an essential weapon for suppressing the enemy in contingencies. The 1st Corps has already been conducting guard duty without loading belts with live ammunition for the K6 heavy machine gun, a core crew-served weapon on our military’s front line [See this newspaper’s July 29, 2026 edition, Page A1]. <<> According to this newspaper’s investigation, the 1st Corps changed the guard duty guidelines during the first half of this year at the discretion of its corps commander, stipulating that no live ammunition be loaded into the K6 and K4. While the 1st Corps has not disclosed the specific reasons for the guideline change, it is known that the aim was to prevent accidental discharges towards the North. <<> The K4 high-speed grenade launcher is a weapon capable of firing 40mm grenades, with destructive power equivalent to hand grenades, at a rate of six rounds per second. This effectively allows for the automatic firing of grenades like a machine gun, and its destructive power surpasses that of the K6 heavy machine gun. It is generally known that at GOPs, each outpost is typically equipped with one K6 and one K4, paired together. However, if live ammunition is not loaded, the ability to respond immediately in a contingency inevitably decreases. <<> Regarding the 1st Corps’ guideline change, some interpretations within the military suggest that a widespread ‘avoid any trouble at all costs’ complacency has led to the cessation of ammunition loading. Some general officers reportedly believe that if an accident occurs during aggressive operations, their promotion becomes difficult, so they focus solely on accident prevention. A military official said, “There are generals so worried about accidental discharges that they would, proverbially speaking, ‘refuse to make soybean paste for fear of maggots’—meaning they avoid loading crew-served weapons.” <<> Another official stated, “If North Korea crosses the Military Demarcation Line (MDL) and moves south, we implement a DMZ operation to later deploy our troops to verify the MDL markers. However, I am aware that last year, some division commanders were reluctant to conduct these operations due to concerns over safety incidents like landmines.” From 2024 to last year, North Korean troops crossed the MDL multiple times while conducting border fortification work, including laying mines around the MDL area. Yet, it is said that “among the current front-line corps commanders, there is a ‘safety-first’ type general who, when ordered by higher command to conduct a DMZ operation, would turn off his secure mobile phone and delay executing the operation.” There are also concerns that, in the aftermath of the December 3 martial law declaration, the military’s principle of ‘orders from above are unquestioningly obeyed’ has weakened, potentially exacerbating this self-protective mentality. <<> A Joint Chiefs of Staff official said on this day, “Currently, the principle for our military’s operation of firearms in forward areas such as GP and GOP is to have live ammunition loaded.” He added, “Regarding the exceptional operation in some units, we plan to conduct on-site verification and take necessary measures.” This implies that when a corps commander changes guard duty guidelines at their discretion, there must be changes in operational conditions, such as environmental changes. The military will investigate whether there was a valid reason for the cessation of ammunition loading and take action accordingly. (서부전선 방어에 핵심 역할을 하는 육군 1군단이 전방 감시초소(GP)와 일반전초(GOP)에 경계 근무 시 K4 고속유탄기관총에도 실탄을 삽탄(揷彈)하지 말라는 지침을 내린 것으로 29일 확인됐다. K4 고속유탄기관총은 최전방 지역 보병들이 쓰는 화기 중 최대 위력을 가져, 유사시 적 제압을 위해 필수적인 무기로 평가된다. 1군단은 우리 군의 최전방 핵심 공용화기인 K6 중(重)기관총에도 실탄이 든 탄띠를 장전하지 않고 경계 근무를 해왔다<본지 2026년 7월 29일자 A1면>.)

item.title: Presidential Office: "Re-election of sitting president constitutionally impossible" Opposition: "Lee must declare there will be no re-election" (靑 “현직 대통령 연임, 헌법상 불가능” 野 “李가 직접 연임 없다고 선언해야”)
item.description:
Presidential Office: "Re-election of sitting president constitutionally impossible" Opposition: "Lee must declare there will be no re-election" (靑 “현직 대통령 연임, 헌법상 불가능” 野 “李가 직접 연임 없다고 선언해야”)

As controversy grew over National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik’s remark that “a constitutional amendment for a sitting president’s re-election is a matter of the people’s choice,” the ruling camp moved to contain the fallout. The presidential office conveyed that “President Lee Jae-myung also said a re-election constitutional amendment is impossible,” and all three candidates for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea also unanimously stated that “it’s hard to gain public consent.” However, the opposition continued its offensive, asking, “Why can’t the president directly say the five words: ‘there will be no re-election’?” <<> Speaker Woo posted on Facebook around 11 p.m. on the 28th, saying, “My remarks at the press conference were meant to clarify the basic procedure that a constitutional amendment requires consensus among political actors and the choice of the people to be achieved,” adding, “I regret causing misunderstanding and controversy contrary to my intention.” Earlier that morning, at his first press conference since taking office, he was asked whether the opposition views the goal of constitutional revision as enabling re-election, and replied, “The re-election issue is ultimately a matter of public opinion and the choice of the sovereign, the people.” Half a day later, as the fallout grew, he issued a clarifying statement. <<> Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik told reporters on the 29th regarding Speaker Woo’s remarks: “President Lee stated during his presidential campaign that the constitutional system does not permit it, the public would not easily tolerate it, and it is realistically impossible.” He added, “If I may add my personal view, I believe Article 128, Paragraph 2 of the Constitution should remain unshaken.” Article 128, Paragraph 2 stipulates that “a constitutional amendment to extend a president’s term or allow re-election shall not take effect for the president in office at the time the amendment is proposed.” Senior Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo also appeared on MBC Radio, stating, “The president is fully aware that a re-election constitutional amendment is not possible and has repeatedly stated this,” and added, “Some are claiming, like a conspiracy theory, that Speaker Woo coordinated with the Blue House, but that never happened.” <<> Candidates for the Democratic Party’s leadership also distanced themselves. Candidate Kim Min-seok posted on X (formerly Twitter), calling it “constitutionally unrealistic,” and said, “It is neither right nor necessary to further inflate an unexpected issue.” Candidate Jeong Cheong-rae said on CBS Radio, “Speaker Woo seems to have been caught off guard by reporters. His details seem a bit lacking.” Candidate Song Young-gil also stated, “I regret that Speaker Woo created room for misunderstanding.” <<> However, some suggested that Speaker Woo’s remarks on re-election constitutional amendments—given his reputation as a “hardcore pro-Lee” figure—could become a disadvantage for pro-Lee candidates Kim Min-seok and Song Young-gil. Candidate Kim Min-seok had said in December last year while serving as Prime Minister, “Five years is too short,” and at a meeting with North Chungcheong Governor Shin Yong-han on the 27th, he asked, “Currently, the president is legally barred from re-election, but you can run again, right?” <<> A key Democratic Party official said, “Yoo Si-min had been facing backlash for his harsh critiques of the president, calling him ‘rotten’ and a ‘sure loser,’ but among the pro-Moon and pro-Roh old mainstream supporters, comments are emerging like, ‘Yoo’s words, which indirectly expressed concerns about indictment cancellation and re-election, turned out to be right.’” Yoo had said in a YouTube broadcast in May that “President Lee’s re-election is constitutionally impossible.” On the same day, Senior Secretary Hong Ik-pyo responded to the so-called “backroom deal for indictment cancellation theory” by stating, “There is no reason to make a backroom deal with the prosecution, nor any intention to do so.” <<> The People Power Party escalated its criticism, demanding, “The president must state his position directly.” President Lee, who is on a diplomatic tour of South America, had not personally stated his position as of that day. This contrasted with his usual behavior of holding senior aide meetings online and posting on X while traveling. <<> People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said, “If (President Lee) clearly declares the five words ‘there will be no re-election’ before the public, all controversy will end in an instant,” adding, “If (Lee) attempts to cancel trials and push for a re-election constitutional amendment, that day will be the last for the Democratic Party and this administration.” Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon remarked, “The National Assembly Speaker, a ‘Lee-pick’ from former President Lee’s political advisory background, brought up the re-election topic,” and claimed, “President Lee is trying to become ‘dictator Lee.’” (조정식 국회의장이 “현직 대통령의 연임 개헌은 국민 선택의 문제”라고 해 논란이 커지자, 여권이 진화에 나섰다. 청와대는 “이재명 대통령도 연임 개헌은 불가능하다고 했다”고 전했고, 더불어민주당 당권 주자 3명도 일제히 “국민 동의를 받기 어려운 얘기”라고 했다. 하지만 야당은 “대통령이 직접 ‘연임은 없다’란 다섯 글자를 왜 말 못 하냐”고 공세를 이어갔다.)

item.title: Lee: "Brazil is the Optimal Partner for Civil Aircraft Development and Mineral Supply Chain" (李 “브라질, 민항기 개발·광물 공급망 최적 파트너”)
item.description:
Lee: "Brazil is the Optimal Partner for Civil Aircraft Development and Mineral Supply Chain" (李 “브라질, 민항기 개발·광물 공급망 최적 파트너”)

President Lee Jae-myung, on a state visit to Brazil, stated on the 28th (local time) regarding Korea-Brazil economic cooperation, "We can achieve significant outcomes in three areas: supply chain cooperation in the critical minerals sector, including joint development of next-generation civil aircraft, and K-Beauty, which is enjoying explosive popularity." (브라질을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 28일(현지 시각) 한·브라질 경제 협력과 관련해 “차세대 민항기 공동 개발을 포함해 핵심 광물 분야의 공급망 협력, 선풍적 인기를 끌고 있는 K뷰티 등 세 분야에서 큰 성과를 만들 수 있을 것”이라고 말했다.)

In a keynote speech at a business roundtable held in São Paulo, Brazil's economic hub, attended by business leaders from both countries, President Lee said, "If Korea's unparalleled innovative technology and manufacturing capabilities combine with Brazil's abundant resources, we can leap forward as optimal partners leading stable supply chains and future industries together." (이 대통령은 이날 브라질 경제 중심인 상파울루에서 양국 기업인 등이 참석한 가운데 열린 비즈니스 라운드테이블 기조 발언을 통해 “한국의 독보적인 혁신 기술과 제조 역량, 브라질의 풍부한 자원이 힘을 합친다면 안정적인 공급망과 미래 산업을 함께 이끄는 최적의 파트너로 도약할 수 있을 것”이라며 이같이 말했다.)

On the occasion of the event, Korea Aerospace Industries (KAI) and Brazilian aerospace company Embraer signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to strengthen cooperation, including joint development in the civil aircraft and aerospace sectors. Embraer is one of the world's top three civil aircraft manufacturers, alongside Boeing in the U.S. and Airbus in Europe, and is also the manufacturer of the C-390 large transport aircraft being introduced by the Republic of Korea Air Force. (이날 행사를 계기로, 한국항공우주산업(KAI)과 브라질의 항공우주 기업 엠브라에르사(社)는 민항기와 항공우주 분야에서 공동 개발 등 협력을 강화하는 양해각서(MOU)를 체결했다. 엠브라에르사는 미국의 보잉, 유럽의 에어버스와 함께 세계 3대 민항기 업체로, 우리 공군이 도입하는 대형 수송기 C-390 제작사이기도 하다.)

POSCO International signed an MOU with Brazilian company Meteoritic Resources to lay the groundwork for securing a stable rare earth supply chain. Brazil holds the world's second-largest rare earth reserves, following China. (포스코 인터내셔널은 브라질 메테오릭리소시스와 안정적인 희토류 공급망 확보를 위한 기반을 마련하는 내용의 양해각서(MOU)를 맺었다. 브라질의 희토류 매장량은 중국에 이어 세계 2위다.)

The joint statement released on the same day also included a commitment to complete all procedures for the risk assessment process required for importing Brazilian beef without delay, provided all conditions are met. It also included continued joint efforts to gain market access for Brazilian pork in South Korea. The two countries agreed to appoint 'personnel dedicated to economic cooperation' to oversee the implementation of the joint statement and other economic cooperation efforts, naming Kim Yong-beom, Chief of the Presidential Office Policy Planning, and Geraldo Alckmin, Vice President of Brazil, respectively. (이날 공개된 공동 성명에는 브라질산 쇠고기 수입에 필요한 위험 평가 과정의 모든 절차를, 모든 조건이 충족되는 경우 지체 없이 완료하기로 하는 내용도 포함됐다. 브라질산 돼지고기의 한국 시장 접근에도 공동 노력을 지속하기로 한다는 내용도 담겼다. 양국은 공동 성명 이행 등 경제 협력을 총괄할 ‘경제 협력 전담 인사’를 두기로 하고, 김용범 청와대 정책실장과 아우키민 브라질 부통령을 각각 지명했다.)

On the same day, President Lee visited the São Paulo Metalworkers' Union office, where Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva once worked as a committee chair, and took a commemorative photo at the seat where President Lula had sat. At a meeting with Korean residents in Brazil, President Lee said, "I tend to travel abroad quite a bit since taking office," adding, "Building substantive trust between leaders rapidly improves conditions for local businesses and expatriates." President Lee will then travel to Chile for a meeting with President José Antonio Kast on the 30th. (이 대통령은 이날 루이스 이나시우 룰라 다 시우바 브라질 대통령이 과거 위원장으로 일했던 상파울루 금속노조 사무실을 방문해, 룰라 대통령이 앉았던 자리에서 기념사진을 찍었다. 브라질 동포 간담회에서 이 대통령은 “취임 뒤 해외 순방을 좀 많이 다니는 편”이라며 “정상 간 실질적 신뢰를 쌓으면 현지 기업, 교민 상황이 매우 신속하게 개선된다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 칠레로 이동해 30일 호세 안토니오 카스트 칠레 대통령과 회담한다.)

item.title: On the "Sure Defeat" Theory… Kim: "Why Did You Say 'No Comment'?" Jung: "Who Do I Need to Insult to Be Pro-Lee?" (李필패론에… 金 “왜 노코멘트라 했나” 鄭 “누굴 욕해야 친명인가”)
item.description:
On the "Sure Defeat" Theory… Kim: "Why Did You Say 'No Comment'?" Jung: "Who Do I Need to Insult to Be Pro-Lee?" (李필패론에… 金 “왜 노코멘트라 했나” 鄭 “누굴 욕해야 친명인가”)

Ahead of the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention, party leadership candidates held their first TV debate on the 29th. Candidates Kim Min-seok, Jung Cheong-rae, and Song Young-gil engaged in heated discussions on issues such as the withdrawal of the indictment against President Lee Jae-myung, responsibility for the June 3 local elections, unification with the Fatherland Innovation Party, and the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority. (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 당대표 후보들이 29일 첫 TV 토론에 나섰다. 김민석·정청래·송영길 후보는 이재명 대통령의 공소 취소 문제, 6·3 지방선거 책임론, 조국혁신당과의 합당, 검찰 보완수사권 폐지와 관련한 문제에 대해 갑론을박을 벌였다.)

In their opening remarks, Candidate Kim emphasized a "stable party leader," Candidate Jung highlighted a "strong reformist party leader," and Candidate Song underscored a "party leader focused on people's livelihoods." The first point of contention arose over the party's internal discussion process regarding the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority. Candidate Kim Min-seok stated, "I advocated for the abolition of the supplementary investigation authority in May. I urged for early action, but I heard it was delayed because Candidate Jung Cheong-rae postponed it." In response, Candidate Jung said, "At the time, General Secretary Kim claimed to have made the request in May, but the bill still hasn't arrived from the government." <<> On the issue of withdrawing the indictment against President Lee Jae-myung, all three candidates agreed that if fabricated charges were revealed, the indictment should be withdrawn. However, they differed on who should be the agent of withdrawal. Candidates Kim and Jung argued that a special counsel investigating fabricated charges could also withdraw the indictment, while Candidate Song countered, "The special counsel should uncover the fabricated charges and prosecute, but once the matter is resolved, it is appropriate for the prosecution, not the special counsel, to withdraw the indictment as a matter of cleaning up their own mess." <<> A debate also ensued over responsibility for the defeat in the June 3 local elections. Candidate Kim said, "In Busan, it was due to a slip of the tongue during the election, and in Pyeongtaek, because the position wasn't well organized, we were practically unable to campaign, weren't we?" He added, "Can these limits on election leadership really be resolved by having the same leader again next year?" In response, Candidate Jung said, "Candidate Kim seems to say that because he has never served as party leader." At this, Candidate Kim brought up Yoo Si-min's recent mention of the 'sure defeat' theory, asking, "Why did you say 'no comment' to such a damning statement? How can you claim to protect the President like that?" Candidate Jung replied, "I hope we don't step on the cross," and added, "Let's not do this thing where insulting someone makes you pro-Lee, and not insulting them makes you something else." However, Candidate Jung refrained from directly addressing Yoo's 'sure defeat' theory until the end. <<> Candidate Kim then alleged that Candidate Jung's camp was inducing votes for three pro-Jung supreme council candidates through so-called "birthday voting" and "odd-even voting," pointing out that this violates party rules and regulations. Candidate Kim stated, "Under the election campaign regulations, the organized act of Candidate Jung gathering with them is precisely factional electioneering, which is defined as illegal." In response, Candidate Jung said, "It's not like I ordered it, is it? When party members act voluntarily, no one can order it or stop it." When Candidate Kim raised the issue again, Candidate Jung retorted, "Candidate Kim was outside the party for 18 years, so he probably doesn't know much about the party's history during the Roh Moo-hyun and Moon Jae-in administrations. This is something party members have always done voluntarily." <<> The candidates also offered differing solutions regarding recent extreme fluctuations in the KOSPI. Candidate Song argued, "We need emergency measures, such as raising the deposit requirement to 10 to 30 million won, restricting day trading, and activating a stock market stabilization fund." In contrast, Candidate Kim said, "Economic policy messages must be cautious. While emergency measures are necessary, it's better to make decisions after sufficient simulation and careful review by authorities, rather than immediately moving to halt trading." <<> On the issue of unification with the pro-government camp, including the Fatherland Innovation Party, Candidates Jung and Song showed differing views. Candidate Jung argued that, for the presidential election, a one-on-one matchup with the conservative camp should be created, and a single candidate should be fielded through measures like introducing a runoff voting system. Conversely, Candidate Song stated, "If I become party leader, I would postpone unification with the Fatherland Innovation Party for a year. I believe we should first focus on expanding support among the 2030 generation, allow the Fatherland Innovation Party to operate independently by easing the requirements for a negotiation group, and then discuss unification ahead of the general election." <<> Following today's debate, the three candidates are scheduled for two more debates: one on KBS on August 5 and another on SBS on August 12. The Democratic Party's August 17 national convention will hold primary elections across the country for three weeks, starting with the Chungcheong region on August 1, with the final results announced on the 17th. (김 후보는 모두 발언에서 ‘안정적인 당대표’를, 정 후보는 ‘강력한 개혁 당대표’를, 송 후보는 ‘민생을 챙기는 당대표’를 각각 강조했다. 이어 검사의 보완수사권 폐지와 관련된 당내 논의 과정이 첫 번째 쟁점이 됐다. 김민석 후보는 “저는 5월에 보완수사권 폐지를 주장했다. 조기에 처리할 것을 주장했는데, 정청래 후보께서 연기해서 늦춰졌다고 들었다”고 했다. 이에 대해 정 후보는 “당시 김 총리가 5월에 요청을 했다고 하는데 (정부에서) 법안이 지금도 안 와있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Ruling Party’s Supplementary Investigation Rights Abolition and Indictment Dismissal Bill to Be Presented at Today’s Plenary Session… Likely to Forcibly Pass on the 31st (與 보완수사권 폐지·공소 기각법 오늘 본회의 상정… 31일 강행 처리될 듯)
item.description:
Ruling Party’s Supplementary Investigation Rights Abolition and Indictment Dismissal Bill to Be Presented at Today’s Plenary Session… Likely to Forcibly Pass on the 31st (與 보완수사권 폐지·공소 기각법 오늘 본회의 상정… 31일 강행 처리될 듯)

The Democratic Party of Korea will present to the National Assembly plenary session on the 30th a revised Criminal Procedure Act that completely abolishes the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights and expands the grounds for which a court can dismiss an indictment filed by the prosecution. The People Power Party plans to block the passage through a filibuster (unlimited debate), but it is expected that the filibuster will be forcibly terminated within 24 hours, allowing the bill to proceed. (더불어민주당이 검찰의 보완수사권을 전면 폐지하고 법원이 검찰이 제기한 공소를 기각할 수 있는 사유를 확대하는 내용의 형사소송법 개정안을 30일 국회 본회의에 상정한다. 국민의힘은 필리버스터(무제한 토론)를 통해 처리를 저지한다는 계획이지만, 필리버스터는 24시간 만에 강제 종료되고 법안이 처리될 것으로 전망된다.)

The Democratic Party passed the revised Criminal Procedure Act the previous day in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee's legislative review subcommittee and plenary session, with People Power Party lawmakers absent. This came just five days after the party decided on the abolition of supplementary investigation rights as its official stance at a general meeting on the 24th. (민주당은 전날 국회 법제사법위원회 법안심사소위와 전체회의에서 국민의힘 의원들이 퇴장한 가운데 형소법 개정안을 의결했다. 지난 24일 의원총회에서 보완수사권 폐지를 당론으로 정한 지 5일 만이다.)

The amendment mainly seeks to completely abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights without exception and replace them with supplementary investigation request rights. During the subcommittee's deliberation, the Democratic Party added two grounds for a court to dismiss an indictment: “when an indictment is filed due to a serious illegal investigation” and “when an indictment is filed with a significant deviation from the prosecutor’s prosecutorial discretion.” In response, the People Power Party criticizes it as “a law to erase the trial of President Lee Jae-myung” and argues, “Since it seems difficult to introduce a special counsel for indictment cancellation, they are creating a detour for the court to dismiss the indictment.” (개정안은 검찰의 보완수사권을 예외 없이 완전히 폐지하고, 보완수사요구권으로 대체하는 것을 주 내용으로 한다. 민주당은 소위 의결 과정에서 법원이 공소를 기각할 수 있는 사유에 ‘중대한 위법 수사에 의해 공소가 제기됐을 때’ ‘(검사의) 소추 재량권을 현저히 일탈해 공소가 제기됐을 때’ 등 두 가지를 추가했다. 이에 대해 국민의힘은 “이재명 대통령의 재판 지우기 법”이라며 “공소 취소 특검 도입이 어려워진다 싶으니까 법원이 공소를 기각하도록 우회로를 만드는 것”이라고 비판하고 있다.)

If the Democratic Party submits the revised Criminal Procedure Act to the plenary session scheduled for 2 p.m. today, the People Power Party is expected to begin a filibuster. The Democratic Party is anticipated to vote on a motion to terminate the filibuster 24 hours later on the afternoon of the 31st, halting the filibuster and then processing the bill. (민주당이 이날 오후 2시 열리는 본회의에 형소법 개정안을 상정하면 국민의힘이 필리버스터를 시작하고, 민주당이 24시간 뒤인 31일 오후 종결 동의안을 표결해 필리버스터를 중단시킨 뒤 법안을 처리할 것으로 예상된다.)

Afterward, the Democratic Party is expected to submit a revised National Assembly Act that shortens the period for entering the fast-track (expedited agenda handling) system. The current fast-track review period, which takes up to 330 days—180 days in standing committees, 90 days in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and 60 days in the plenary session—would be reduced to 60 days in standing committees, 30 days in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and submission to the first plenary session after being placed on the agenda. While the People Power Party plans to filibuster this bill as well, the shortened parliamentary session, which ends on the 31st, is expected to automatically terminate the filibuster at midnight that day. The revised National Assembly Act could then be immediately voted on at the first subsequent plenary session. (이후에는 민주당이 패스트트랙(안건 신속 처리) 제도에 들어가는 기간을 단축하는 국회법 개정안을 상정할 것으로 전망된다. 현재 ‘상임위원회 180일, 법사위 90일, 본회의 60일’ 등 최장 330일이 걸리는 패스트트랙 심사 기간을 ‘상임위 60일, 법사위 30일, 본회의 부의 후 첫 본회의 상정’으로 줄이는 내용이다. 국민의힘은 이 법안에도 필리버스터를 할 계획이지만, 민주당이 단축한 회기가 31일로 끝나면서 이날 자정에 필리버스터가 자동으로 종료될 전망이다. 국회법 개정안은 이후 열리는 국회 첫 본회의에서 곧바로 의결될 수 있다.)

item.title: Poll for Democratic Party Leader: Jung Cheong-rae 36.9%, Kim Min-seok 28.0%… Second Preference Vote Goes to Song Young-gil 33.9%, Kim Min-seok 12.9% (與 당대표 여론조사 정청래 36.9% 김민석 28.0%… 선호투표 2순위는 송영길 33.9% 김민석 12.9%)
item.description:
Poll for Democratic Party Leader: Jung Cheong-rae 36.9%, Kim Min-seok 28.0%… Second Preference Vote Goes to Song Young-gil 33.9%, Kim Min-seok 12.9% (與 당대표 여론조사 정청래 36.9% 김민석 28.0%… 선호투표 2순위는 송영길 33.9% 김민석 12.9%)

In a poll for the Democratic Party's August 17 national convention leadership election, conducted under a preferential voting system, 36.9% of respondents said they would vote for candidate Jung Cheong-rae as their first preference, the highest figure. Candidate Kim Min-seok received 28.0%, and candidate Song Young-gil 9.2%. (선호투표제로 치러지는 더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거에서 1순위를 정청래 후보에게 투표하겠다는 응답자가 36.9%로 가장 많다는 여론조사 결과가 나왔다. 김민석 후보는 28.0%, 송영길 후보는 9.2%였다.)

According to results released on the 30th by polling agency Media Tomato, commissioned by News Tomato and conducted on the 27th and 28th, in a hypothetical three-way race for the convention, 36.9% of respondents said they would give their first preference vote to Jung, 28.0% to Kim, and 9.2% to Song. Those who had no preferred candidate accounted for 21.8%, and 4.1% were unsure. (여론조사 업체 미디어토마토가 뉴스토마토 의뢰로 27~28일 조사해 30일 공개한 결과에 따르면, 전당대회 가상 3자 대결 조사에서 선호투표 1순위를 정 후보에게 주겠다는 응답자가 36.9%, 김 후보에게 주겠다는 응답자가 28.0%, 송 후보에게 주겠다는 응답자가 9.2%였다. 선호하는 후보가 없다는 응답자는 21.8%, 잘 모르겠다는 응답자는 4.1%였다.)

By region, the ratio of respondents favoring Jung over Kim was as follows: Incheon/Gyeonggi 39.4% to 24.5%, Daegu/North Gyeongsang 38.7% to 21.8%, and Busan/Ulsan/South Gyeongsang 38.7% to 28.9%, showing Jung's dominance. Kim led in Gangwon/Jeju with 20.7% versus 33.3%, while the figures were similar in Seoul (32.4% vs. 31.5%) and Honam (37.3% vs. 34.9%). (응답자 지역별로 보면, 정 후보와 김 후보 선호 응답자 비율은 인천·경기에서 39.4%대24.5%, 대구·경북에서 38.7%대21.8%, 부산·울산·경남에서 38.7%대28.9%로 정 후보가 우세했다. 강원·제주에서는 20.7%대33.3%로 김 후보가 앞섰고, 서울에서는 32.4%대31.5%, 호남에서는 37.3%대34.9%로 비슷했다.)

By age group, Jung outpaced Kim among those in their 60s (46.1% vs. 21.6%), 50s (42.8% vs. 33.2%), 70s and older (33.2% vs. 25.8%), and 30s (32.1% vs. 25.7%). In the 40s (36.9% vs. 33.8%) and among those aged 10–20s (18–29 years) (26.8% vs. 27.5%), the figures were similar. (응답자 연령별로 보면, 정 후보는 60대에서 46.1%대21.6%, 50대에서 42.8%대33.2%, 70대 이상에서 33.2%대25.8%, 30대에서 32.1%대25.7%로 김 후보를 앞섰다. 40대에서는 36.9%대33.8%, 10·20대(18~29세)에서는 26.8%대27.5%로 비슷했다.)

However, when limited to Democratic Party supporters, Kim Min-seok was the highest at 44.9%, followed by Jung at 38.9% and Song at 11.2%. Among supporters of the Rebuilding Korea Party, Jung led with 54.4%, Kim at 15.2%, and Song at 13.0%. Among supporters of the People Power Party, Jung had 38.7%, Kim 10.1%, and Song 5.9%. Since this Democratic Party leadership election combines delegate/party member votes and public opinion polls in a 70% to 30% ratio, supporters of other parties can also participate. (반면 민주당 지지층으로 한정해서 보면, 김 후보가 44.9%로 가장 높았다. 정 후보는 38.9%, 송 후보는 11.2%였다. 조국혁신당 지지층에서는 정 후보 54.4%, 김 후보 15.2%, 송 후보 13.0%였다. 국민의힘 지지층에서는 정 후보 38.7%, 김 후보 10.1%, 송 후보 5.9%였다. 이번 민주당 당대표 선거는 대의원·권리당원 투표와 국민 여론조사를 70%대30%로 합산해 치러지기 때문에, 다른 당 지지층도 참여할 수 있다.)

Meanwhile, due to the preferential voting system, the candidate finishing third in the first-preference votes is eliminated first, and those votes are redistributed to the first- and second-place candidates according to the second-preference ratios of voters who voted for the third-place candidate. In this regard, 33.9% of respondents said they would give their second preference to Song Young-gil, the highest figure. Those favoring Kim Min-seok in second preference were 12.9%, and Jung Cheong-rae 9.0%. Those with no preferred candidate for second preference were 37.4%, and 6.7% were unsure. Among Democratic Party supporters, Song had 51.3%, Kim 17.1%, and Jung 9.6%. (한편 선호투표제로 인해 1순위 투표를 합산한 결과에서 3위를 차지한 후보가 먼저 탈락하고, 그 표가 3위 후보에게 투표한 유권자들의 2순위 투표 비율대로 1·2위 후보에게 배분되는데, 선호투표 2순위를 송 후보에게 주겠다는 응답자가 33.9%로 가장 많았다. 김 후보에게 주겠다는 응답자는 12.9%, 정 후보에게 주겠다는 응답자는 9.0%였다. 주고 싶은 후보가 없다는 응답자는 37.4%, 잘 모르겠다는 응답자는 6.7%였다. 민주당 지지층에서도 송 후보 51.3%, 김 후보 17.1%, 정 후보 9.6%였다.)

In a survey of preference for eight Supreme Council candidates, Choi Min-hee ranked highest at 15.0%, followed by Park Sun-won at 14.7%. Next were Seo Mi-hwa at 6.8%, Kim Yong at 6.0%, Lee Seong-yoon at 5.4%, Han Min-soo at 4.7%, Im Mi-ae at 4.6%, and Kim Young-ho at 2.6%. Respondents with no preferred candidate were 29.2%, and 11.0% were unsure. (최고위원 후보 8인 선호도 조사에서는 최민희 후보가 15.0%로 가장 높았고, 박선원 후보가 14.7%로 그다음이었다. 이어 서미화 후보 6.8%, 김용 후보 6.0%, 이성윤 후보 5.4%, 한민수 후보 4.7%, 임미애 후보 4.6%, 김영호 후보 2.6% 순이었다. 선호 후보가 없다는 응답자는 29.2%, 잘 모르겠다는 응답자는 11.0%였다.)

Among Democratic Party supporters, Choi Min-hee had 13.3%, Park Sun-won 11.1%, Seo Mi-hwa 8.7%, Lee Seong-yoon 6.5%, Kim Yong 6.4%, Im Mi-ae 5.2%, Han Min-soo 2.9%, and Kim Young-ho 2.6%. (민주당 지지층에서는 최민희 후보 13.3%, 박선원 후보 11.1%, 서미화 후보 8.7%, 이성윤 후보 6.5%, 김용 후보 6.4%, 임미애 후보 5.2%, 한민수 후보 2.9%, 김영호 후보 2.6% 순이었다.)

Regarding President Lee Jae-myung's state administration, 51.7% of respondents gave a positive evaluation, up 1.9 percentage points (p) from last week's 49.8%. Negative evaluations stood at 43.6%, down 1.8p from the previous week's 45.4%. <<>>> In a party approval rating survey, the Democratic Party scored 46.0%, down 0.6p from last week, while the People Power Party rose to 31.3%, up 2.3p from last week. This was followed by the Rebuilding Korea Party at 3.5%, the Reform Party at 3.0%, and the Progressive Party at 1.4%. Those supporting other parties were 2.4%, those with no party preference were 11.2%, and 1.1% were unsure. (이재명 대통령의 국정 운영에 대해서는 긍정 평가한 응답자가 51.7%로, 지난주 49.8%보다 1.9%포인트(p) 늘었다. 부정 평가한 응답자는 43.6%로, 지난주 45.4%보다 1.8%p 줄었다.)

This survey was conducted over two days on the 27th and 28th, targeting 1,033 people aged 18 and older nationwide using an automated wireless telephone response (ARS) method. The response rate was 1.7%, with a margin of error of ±3.0 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. For more details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Committee. (정당 지지율 조사에서는 민주당이 46.0%로 지난주보다 0.6%p 떨어졌고, 국민의힘이 31.3%로 지난주보다 2.3%p 올랐다. 이어 조국혁신당 3.5%, 개혁신당 3.0%, 진보당 1.4% 순이었다. 그 외 다른 정당을 지지한다는 응답자는 2.4%, 지지 정당이 없다는 응답자는 11.2%, 잘 모르겠다는 응답자는 1.1%였다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Chile is the first FTA partner... Bound by deep friendship" (李대통령 “칠레는 FTA 최초 파트너...깊은 우정으로 이어져 있다”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Chile is the first FTA partner... Bound by deep friendship" (李대통령 “칠레는 FTA 최초 파트너...깊은 우정으로 이어져 있다”)

President Lee Jae-myung, on an official visit to Chile, met with local compatriots on the 29th (local time) and stated, "Chile was not only the first country in Latin America to recognize the Republic of Korea government, but also South Korea's first free trade agreement (FTA) partner," adding, "At the heart of the special bond between South Korea and Chile are you, our compatriots." (칠레를 공식 방문한 이재명 대통령은 29일(현지 시각) 현지 동포들을 만나 “칠레는 중남미 국가 중 제일 처음으로 대한민국 정부를 승인해 줬을 뿐만 아니라 대한민국 최초의 자유무역협정(FTA) 파트너”라며 “한국과 칠레의 특별한 인연 중심에 바로 우리 동포 여러분이 계시다”라고 했다.)

At a compatriot gathering held in Chile's capital, Santiago, that day, President Lee said, "Although Chile is one of the farthest countries from South Korea on a map, the heart of deep friendship has always been closely connected." (이 대통령은 이날 칠레 수도 산티아고에서 열린 동포 간담회에서 “칠레는 지도상으로 보면 대한민국의 가장 먼 나라 중 하나이지만 깊은 우정의 마음이 늘 가까이 이어져 있다”며 이같이 말했다.)

President Lee acknowledged that the geographical distance between South Korea and Chile is "truly vast." Yet he added, "When we recall the history we have shared together, the distance between our two countries feels much closer than that," attributing this to "the heart of deep friendship that is always closely linked." (이 대통령은 대한민국과 칠레의 지리적 거리가 “정말로 멀긴 멀다”고 했다. 그러면서도 “우리가 함께 공유해 온 역사를 떠올려보면 두 나라 사이의 거리는 그보다 훨씬 가깝다”며 “깊은 우정의 마음이 늘 가까이 이어져 있기 때문”이라고 했다.)

Regarding Chile being the first Latin American country to officially recognize the South Korean government in 1949, President Lee said, "It is a grateful nation that recognized our potential and extended a hand during a time when the world knew little about South Korea." Concerning the fact that Chile was the first country to sign an FTA with South Korea, he remarked, "When South Korea began to open its economic doors to the world, Chile became our precious partner." (이 대통령은 칠레가 1949년 중남미 국가 중 대한민국 정부를 가장 먼저 공식 승인한 점에 대해 “전 세계가 대한민국에 대해 잘 알지 못했던 시절에 우리의 가능성을 먼저 알아보고 손을 내밀어준 고마운 나라”라고 했다. 가장 먼저 FTA를 체결한 국가라는 점에 대해서도 “대한민국이 세계를 향해 경제 문을 넓히기 시작했을 때 칠레가 우리의 소중한 동반자가 되어 주었던 것”이라고 했다.)

President Lee stated, "Now, through K-pop, K-dramas, Korean cuisine, and the Korean language, we are witnessing a new future in South Korea-Chile relations, where the people of both countries share deeper trust and friendship," adding, "The horizons of cooperation between our two countries are gradually broadening, spanning critical minerals, clean energy, digital and artificial intelligence, science and technology, to culture." He continued, "I trust that you, our compatriots who serve as a sturdy bridge in bilateral relations, will join us to the end on this journey to create new history." (이 대통령은 “우리는 지금 K팝과 K드라마, 한식과 한국어를 매개로 양국 국민이 더 깊은 신뢰와 우정의 마음을 나누는 한·칠레 관계의 새로운 미래를 목격하고 있다”며 “핵심 광물, 청정 에너지, 디지털과 인공지능, 과학기술과 문화에 이르기까지 양국 간의 협력의 지평은 점차 더 넓어지고 있다”고 했다. 이어 “양국 관계의 튼튼한 가교 역할을 맡아준 동포 여러분께서 새로운 역사를 만들어가는 여정에 끝까지 함께해 주실 것으로 믿는다”고 했다.)

item.title: Review of 11,165 Criminal Penalty Provisions... ‘Government-Wide Penalty Rationalization Task Force’ Launches (1만1165개 형벌 규정 재검토… ‘범정부 형벌 합리화 추진단’ 출범)
item.description:
Review of 11,165 Criminal Penalty Provisions... ‘Government-Wide Penalty Rationalization Task Force’ Launches (1만1165개 형벌 규정 재검토… ‘범정부 형벌 합리화 추진단’ 출범)

A ‘government-wide penalty rationalization task force’ was launched on the 30th to promote the ‘rationalization of administrative penalties,’ including the conversion of criminal penalties in economic laws into financial liabilities such as fines and administrative fines. (경제 법률의 형사처벌을 과징금·과태료와 같은 금전적 책임으로 전환하는 것을 비롯한 ‘행정 형벌 합리화’를 추진하기 위한 ‘범정부 형벌 합리화’ 추진단이 30일 출범했다.)

According to the Ministry of Government Legislation, the task force consists of about 40 members, including public officials and researchers dispatched from the Ministry of Government Legislation, the Ministry of Economy and Finance, the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries. Choi Young-chan, Deputy Minister of Government Legislation, will serve as the head of the task force, and its operational period is two years. (법제처에 따르면, 추진단은 법제처와 재정경제부, 법무부, 국토교통부, 해양수산부 등에서 파견된 공무원과 연구원 등 40명 안팎으로 구성되고, 최영찬 법제처 차장이 단장을 맡는다. 활동 기간은 2년이다.)

The task force plans to conduct a comprehensive survey of all 11,165 criminal penalty provisions in current laws to review whether the types and levels of penalties are appropriate. Additionally, it will establish ‘comprehensive standards for penalty rationalization’ and develop measures to redefine penalties for each crime based on these standards. (추진단은 전체 법률에 있는 형벌 규정 1만1165개를 전수 조사해, 벌칙의 종류나 수위가 적절한지를 재검토할 계획이다. 또 ‘형벌 합리화 종합 기준’을 만들어, 이 기준에 따라 각 범죄에 대한 벌칙을 다시 정하는 방안을 마련한다.)

The business community has pointed out that domestic economic laws are overly focused on criminal penalties, excessively restricting the scope of activities for corporate leaders. According to a survey by the Korea Economic Association last year, 346 laws under 21 ministries, closely related to corporate activities, designate a total of 8,403 violations as subject to criminal penalties. In response, the Lee Jae-myung government selected “shifting from penalty-centered sanctions to a civil liability-oriented approach and rationalizing economic penalties” as a national agenda item. (경제계는 국내 경제 법률이 형사처벌 위주로 돼 있어 기업인들의 활동 범위를 지나치게 제약한다고 지적해 왔다. 지난해 한국경제인협회의 조사 결과에 따르면, 기업 활동과 관련이 높은 21개 부처 소관 346개 법률이 총 8403개의 위반 행위를 형사처벌 대상으로 규정하고 있다. 이에 따라 이재명 정부는 “형벌 중심 제재에서 민사적 책임 중심으로의 전환 등 경제 형벌 합리화를 추진하겠다”며 이를 국정 과제로 선정했다.)

The Ministry of Government Legislation stated, “The implementation of penalty rationalization is expected not only to establish a fair penalty system aligned with the severity of crimes and accountability but also to reduce unnecessary social and administrative costs through the reorganization of penalty regulations in line with changing times, thereby promoting economic activities for citizens and businesses and positively impacting national competitiveness and economic revitalization.” (법제처는 “형벌 합리화가 추진되면 범죄의 경중과 책임에 맞는 공정한 형벌 체계를 마련할 수 있을 뿐 아니라, 시대의 변화에 부합하는 합리적인 형벌 규정 정비로 불필요한 사회적·행정적 비용을 줄여 국민과 기업의 경제 활동을 촉진하는 등 국가 경쟁력과 경제 활성화에 긍정적 효과를 가져올 것으로 기대된다”고 했다.)

The Ministry also said, “To gather diverse opinions, we will operate an advisory committee comprising experts from academia and the legal profession, and continuously identify difficulties faced by citizens and businesses to derive practical, field-oriented improvement measures.” (법제처는 또 “다양한 의견을 수렴하기 위해 학계·법조계 등의 전문가로 구성된 자문위원회를 운영하고, 현장 중심의 실질적인 개선안을 도출하기 위해 국민과 기업이 겪고 있는 어려움을 상시 발굴할 예정”이라고 했다.)

The Ministry particularly noted, “Immediately upon launch, the task force will conduct preliminary investigations on approximately 1,200 penalty provisions selected based on importance and ripple effects. By the end of this year, we will establish and announce comprehensive standards for penalty rationalization and a ‘two-year roadmap’ based on these findings.” (법제처는 특히 “추진단이 출범 즉시 중요도와 파급력을 고려해 선정한 약 1200개 형벌 규정에 대해 선행 조사를 실시하고, 이를 기반으로 형벌 합리화 종합 기준과 ‘2개년 로드맵’을 올해 안으로 마련해 발표할 것”이라고 했다.)

However, penalty rationalization does not necessarily mean lowering the level of sanctions. President Lee, during a Cabinet meeting in April, was briefed on the penalty rationalization plan and stated, “Since almost everything can be punished, criminal penalties are overused, effectively undermining the principle of legality.” He added, “In the past, with limited economic power, fines were considered ineffective, leading to criminal penalties. But now, economic sanctions are far more effective.” He emphasized the need to design penalties around fines and administrative fines while also arguing, “If a 5 million won fine is converted to an administrative fine, the amount should be set at 50 million won or 100 million won.” (다만 형벌 합리화가 반드시 제재 수위를 지금보다 낮춘다는 의미는 아니다. 이 대통령은 지난 4월 국무회의에서 형벌 합리화 방안을 보고받고 “웬만한 일은 다 처벌할 수 있게 돼 있다 보니 형사처벌이 남발되면서 죄형 법정주의가 사실상 무너진 상황”이라고 했다. 이어 “옛날에야 경제력이 없으니 과징금도 효과가 별로 없다고 생각해 형사처벌을 했을 수 있지만, 지금은 경제 제재가 오히려 큰 효과가 있는 시대”라며 과징금이나 과태료를 중심으로 형벌을 설계해야 한다고 했다. 그러면서도 “벌금 500만원을 과태료로 바꿔준다면 그 액수는 5000만원, 1억원 등으로 해야 한다”고 주장했다.)

item.title: People Power Party Expands Ethics Committee by 2 Amid Internal Strife... Will Jang Push Ahead with Disciplinary Action? (국힘, ‘내홍’ 윤리위 2명 충원…張, 징계 강행하나)
item.description:
People Power Party Expands Ethics Committee by 2 Amid Internal Strife... Will Jang Push Ahead with Disciplinary Action? (국힘, ‘내홍’ 윤리위 2명 충원…張, 징계 강행하나)

As the Central Ethics Committee of the People Power Party (PPP) is engulfed in internal conflict, the party's Supreme Council appointed two additional members to the committee on the 30th. This move fills the vacancies left by the recent resignations of two ethics committee members, suggesting that the disciplinary politics of the Jang Dong-hyuk leadership will continue for the time being. During this process, some Supreme Council members opposed the additional appointments. (국민의힘 중앙윤리위원회가 내홍에 휩싸인 가운데 당 최고위원회가 30일 중앙윤리위원 2명을 추가로 임명했다. 최근 윤리위원 2명이 사퇴한 데 따른 충원으로, 장동혁 지도부의 징계 정치가 당분간 이어질 것이라는 전망이 나온다. 이 과정에서 일부 최고위원은 윤리위원 추가 임명에 반발했다.)

Chief Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon told reporters after the Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, that day, "Recently, two ethics committee members resigned after their names were made public in the media, causing them pressure and burden. Considering this, we appointed two additional members." According to the PPP's party constitution and regulations, the ethics committee can consist of up to nine members. Initially, the committee had seven members, but after two recently resigned, it had been operating with five. (최보윤 수석대변인은 이날 서울 여의도 국회에서 열린 최고위 직후 기자들과 만나 “(최근) 윤리위원 2명이 실명이 언론에 공개돼 압박과 부담을 느껴 사임했는데, 이를 고려해 추가 2명을 임명했다”고 말했다. 국민의힘 당헌·당규상 윤리위원은 9인 이내로 구성할 수 있다. 당초 7명이었던 당 윤리위원 중 2명이 최근 사임해 5명 체제로 운영되고 있었다.)

During the closed-door meeting that day, it is known that PPP Leader Jang Dong-hyuk and Youth Supreme Council member Woo Jae-joon engaged in a heated exchange over the additional appointments. Woo reportedly argued that an investigation into the recent internal strife within the ethics committee was necessary, while Jang responded that the committee could not be left vacant and thus needed to be filled. Ultimately, the additional appointments were put to a vote. (이날 비공개 회의에서는 윤리위원 추가 임명을 둘러싸고 장동혁 대표와 우재준 청년최고위원이 설전을 벌인 것으로 알려졌다. 우 최고위원은 최근 윤리위 내홍에 대해 조사가 필요하다는 취지로 설명했고 장 대표는 윤리위를 공백 상태로 둘 수 없어 일단은 충원을 해야한다고 답한 것으로 알려졌다. 결국 윤리위원 추가 임명은 표결에 부쳐졌다.)

Woo left the meeting early and told reporters, "I believe there is a need to investigate what is happening in the ethics committee, where resignations are occurring consecutively, and whether it is being operated in a biased manner," adding, "I opposed the move on the grounds that I cannot agree with the approach of simply filling the vacancies and pushing ahead." (우 최고위원은 회의장에서 먼저 나와 기자들과 만나 “(윤리위원 사퇴가 잇따르고 있는) 윤리위에서 어떤 일이 일어나고 있는지, 편향적으로 운영되는 게 아닌지 조사해야 하는 상황이라고 생각한다”며 “공백만 채워서 강행하겠다는 기조에 대해 동의할 수 없다는 취지에서 반대했다”고 했다.)

The party's ethics committee has recently been experiencing internal strife. On the 27th, the committee decided to initiate disciplinary proceedings against lawmakers Cho Kyung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, and Jin Jong-oh, with only three members in attendance. Vice Chairman Woo Jong-hwan and member Hwang Kyung-sun, who did not attend the meeting, issued a statement shortly before it, saying, "Chairman Yoon Min-woo and member Jeong Kyung-wook should publicly apologize for announcing disciplinary standards that amount to a loyalty oath to the party leader," and added, "We will not tolerate the use of the independent ethics committee as a personal political ladder." (최근 당 윤리위는 내홍을 겪고 있다. 윤리위는 지난 27일 3명의 윤리위원만 참석한 가운데 조경태·권영진·진종오 의원에 대한 징계 개시를 결정했다. 이날 회의에 참석하지 않은 우종환 윤리위 부위원장과 황경선 윤리위원은 이날 회의 직전 성명서를 내고 “윤민우 위원장과 정경욱 윤리위원은 당대표에 대한 충성 맹세용 징계 기준 발표에 대해 공개 사과하라”면서 “독립 기구인 윤리위를 개인의 정치적 사다리로 이용하는 것을 좌시하지 않을 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Pro-Moon Kim Young-jin: "National Assembly Speaker Should Apologize for Remarks on Presidential Term Renewal and Constitutional Amendment" (친명 김영진 “국회의장 ‘연임 개헌’ 발언 사과해야”)
item.description:
Pro-Moon Kim Young-jin: "National Assembly Speaker Should Apologize for Remarks on Presidential Term Renewal and Constitutional Amendment" (친명 김영진 “국회의장 ‘연임 개헌’ 발언 사과해야”)

Regarding National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik’s statement that "allowing a constitutional amendment to extend the incumbent president's term is a matter of public choice," pro-Moon faction lawmaker Kim Young-jin of the Democratic Party of Korea said, "He needs to apologize for his misstatement." (조정식 국회의장이 “현직 대통령의 연임 개헌은 국민 선택의 문제”라고 말한 데 대해 친명계 김영진 더불어민주당 의원은 “본인의 실언에 대한 사과가 필요하다”고 했다.)

Appearing on MBC Radio’s "Kim Jong-bae’s Focus" on the morning of the 30th, Rep. Kim noted, "Speaker Woo is one of the more cautious lawmakers," adding, "I’m puzzled as to why he made such a remark." (김 의원은 30일 아침 MBC라디오 ‘김종배의 시선집중’에 출연해 “조 의장이 상당히 신중한 의원 중에 한 분”이라며 “왜 그런 발언을 했을까에 대해 의문이 들었다”고 했다.)

Rep. Kim continued, "Speaker Woo clearly stated that it was his mistake—a slip of the tongue. He said he did not mean to suggest the concept of allowing a presidential term renewal through constitutional revision. He explained that he was making a general point that constitutional amendments inevitably involve public judgment, but that this was linked to the idea of extending the president’s term and was subject to expanded interpretation." (김 의원은 이어 “조 의장이 명확하게 본인의 실수, 실언이었다. 그런 (연임 개헌) 개념으로 이야기한 것은 아니었다. 헌법 개정에서 국민적인 판단이 있을 수밖에 없다고 하는 일반론적인 이야기를 한 것인데 그것이 대통령 연임과 결부돼 나가면서 확대 해석되는 측면이 있다고 이야기했다”고 전했다.)

During a press briefing on the 28th, Speaker Woo, when asked about the possibility of amending the Constitution to allow an extension of the incumbent president’s term or re-election, said, "It depends on how the various political stakeholders reach an agreement" and "Ultimately, it’s a matter of public opinion and the choice of the sovereign people, the citizens." After the remarks sparked controversy, Woo posted on Facebook the same day, stating, "Allowing the incumbent president’s re-election is not a topic for constitutional amendment discussions," and added, "I regret causing misunderstandings and controversy contrary to my original intent." (조 의장은 지난 28일 기자 간담회에서 현직 대통령의 임기 연장이나 연임 허용을 막는 헌법 조항의 개정 가능성에 대해 “여러 정치적 당사자가 어떻게 합의하느냐에 달린 문제”라며 “결국 주권자인 국민 여론과 국민 선택의 문제”라고 했다. 발언이 논란이 되자 조 의장은 같은 날 페이스북에 글을 올려 “현직 대통령의 연임은 개헌 논의 대상이 아니다”라며 “본의와 다르게 오해와 논란을 불러일으킨 점에 대해 유감스럽게 생각한다”고 했다.)

Rep. Kim asserted, "A constitutional amendment for term renewal is both constitutionally and realistically impossible." Nonetheless, he added, "Because this issue has significant repercussions, (Speaker Woo’s Facebook post) likely won’t resolve it so easily." (김 의원은 “(연임 개헌은) 헌법적으로도 불가능하고 현실적으로 불가능한 이야기”라고 단언했다. 그러면서도 “이것이 대단히 파급력이 큰 사안이었기 때문에, (조 의장이 페이스북에 올린 글로) 그렇게 쉽게 마무리될 것 같지 않다”고 했다.)

Rep. Kim said, "In the upcoming second half of the National Assembly, the Democratic Party had a broad plan—through the Special Committee on Constitutional Amendment—to first advance easily agreeable parts, such as enshrining the spirit of the May 18 Democratization Movement in the Constitution’s preamble or strengthening martial law requirements to prevent another insurrectionary martial law, while discussing more difficult issues later with the ruling and opposition parties to reach a consensus on constitutional revision. But now, (Speaker Woo’s remarks) have created an obstacle." He added, "The opposition party could very well launch attacks asking why he said such a thing." (김 의원은 “이번 하반기 국회에서 민주당이 헌법개정특별위원회를 통해 5·18 정신의 헌법 전문 수록이라든지 계엄 요건을 강화해서 다시는 내란 계엄이 없게끔 한다든지 등 쉽게 합의할 수 있는 부분은 먼저 진행하고 어려운 문제는 추후 논의해 가면서 여야가 합의해서 헌법 개정을 해나가자는 큰 이야기를 했는데, 거기에 (조 의장의 발언으로) 장애물이 생긴 상황”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “야당에서도 (조 의장이) 왜 그런 말을 했을까에 대해 공격은 다분히 있을 수 있다”고 했다.)

Rep. Kim argued, "Speaker Woo, in his position as National Assembly Speaker, must respond to those attacks, and an appropriate apology and clarification are necessary." (김 의원은 “그 공격에 대해 조 의장이 국회의장의 위치에서 대응하고, 그에 상응하는 사과와 입장이 필요하다”고 주장했다.)

The host asked, "Given the opposition’s offensive, it seems Speaker Woo’s explanations have limits. Is there any room to consider President Lee Jae-myung declaring, 'There will be no term extension'?" In response, Rep. Kim refuted, "President Lee clearly stated during the 2022 and 2025 presidential elections regarding a constitutional amendment for term renewal that 'it is clearly impossible both constitutionally and realistically, so why ask about my feelings on that?' The chief of staff and senior secretary for political affairs, who convey the president’s will and intent, have also made a clear stance." He added, "Any further comments could spark another controversy." (진행자가 “야당이 펴는 공세로 볼 때 조 의장이 해명을 해봤자 한계가 있는 것 같다”며 “이재명 대통령이 ‘연임은 없다’고 선언하는 것을 검토해볼 여지가 없느냐”고 물었다. 이에 대해 김 의원은 “이 대통령은 2022년, 2025년 대선에서 연임 개헌에 관해 ‘헌법상으로도 현실적으로도 불가능한 것이 명확한데 거기에 대해서 나의 마음을 뭘 물어보느냐’고 분명히 언급했고, 대통령의 의지와 뜻을 전하는 비서실장과 정무수석이 명확한 입장을 표명했다”고 반박했다. 그러면서 “또 다른 발언은 또 다른 논란을 불러낼 수 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Ruling and Opposition Parties Agree on Special Counsel Bill for Election Commission… Extend Parliamentary Inquiry by 30 Days for Recount (여야, 선관위 특검법 합의…재검표 위해 국조 30일 연장)
item.description:
Ruling and Opposition Parties Agree on Special Counsel Bill for Election Commission… Extend Parliamentary Inquiry by 30 Days for Recount (여야, 선관위 특검법 합의…재검표 위해 국조 30일 연장)

The Democratic Party of Korea and the People Power Party reached an agreement on the key issues of a special counsel bill on the 30th, aimed at investigating the ballot shortage during the 9th National Simultaneous Local Elections and allegations of election management failures. The ruling and opposition parties also decided to extend the activities of the National Assembly's Special Committee on the Parliamentary Inquiry into the National Election Commission by 30 days. (더불어민주당과 국민의힘이 30일 제9회 전국동시지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태와 선거관리 부실 의혹을 규명하기 위한 특별검사법의 주요 쟁점에 합의했다. 여야는 선거관리위원회 국정조사특별위원회의 활동 기간도 30일 연장하기로 했다.)

Cheon Jun-ho, the Democratic Party's Senior Deputy Majority Whip, and Kim Seung-su, the People Power Party's Senior Deputy Majority Whip, made this announcement after meeting at the National Assembly and speaking with reporters. (천준호 민주당 원내운영수석부대표와 김승수 국민의힘 원내운영수석부대표는 이날 국회에서 회동한 뒤 기자들과 만나 이같이 밝혔다.)

The name of the special counsel bill was decided as the "Act on the Appointment of a Special Counsel for Fact-Finding into Allegations of Infringement on Citizens' Right to Participate in Elections, Including the Ballot Shortage Incident in the 9th Simultaneous Local Elections." (특검법의 명칭은 ‘제9회 동시지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등 국민참정권 침해 의혹 진상규명을 위한 특별검사의 임명 등에 관한 법률안’으로 정했다.)

Following an earlier agreement on the method of recommending the special counsel, the ruling and opposition parties also reached a consensus on key issues such as the scope and targets of the investigation. The specific subjects of the investigation are expected to be finalized through legislative drafting based on agreements between the floor leaders of both parties' Legislation and Judiciary Committee. (여야는 앞서 특검 추천 방식에 합의한 데 이어 이날 수사 대상과 범위 등 핵심 쟁점에 대해서도 의견을 모았다. 구체적인 수사 대상은 양당 법제사법위원회 간사가 합의 내용을 토대로 조문 작업을 거쳐 확정할 예정이다.)

Cheon said, "Excluding minor details, the agreement is complete," adding, "If the agreement is forwarded to the floor leaders of both parties' Judiciary Committees, I believe the bill will be completed quickly." (천 수석부대표는 “세부 쟁점을 제외하고는 합의가 완료됐다”며 “합의서를 양당 법사위 간사에게 전달하면 신속하게 법안이 완성될 것으로 생각한다”고 말했다.)

Kim also stated, "The two parties have consulted for a long time over the subjects of the investigation and have agreed on the main issues," and added, "We have decided to pass the special counsel bill at today's plenary session after the Judiciary Committee's drafting work." (김 수석부대표도 “수사 대상을 두고 양당이 오랜 기간 협의했고 주요 쟁점에 합의했다”며 “법사위의 조문 작업을 거쳐 오늘 오후 본회의에서 특검법을 처리하기로 했다”고 밝혔다.)

The ruling and opposition parties also agreed to extend the activities of the National Assembly's Special Committee on the Parliamentary Inquiry into the Election Commission, which was set to end on the 31st, by 30 days. During the extended period, preparations for a recount of ballots stored at the Olympic Park vote-counting station in Seoul's Songpa District will be conducted. (여야는 오는 31일 종료 예정이던 선관위 국조특위의 활동 기간을 30일 연장하는 데도 합의했다. 연장된 활동 기간에는 서울 송파구 올림픽공원 개표소에 보관 중인 투표지의 재검표를 위한 준비 작업이 진행될 예정이다.)

Cheon explained, "We decided to extend the activities of the Parliamentary Inquiry Special Committee to prepare for the recount of ballots at the Olympic Park vote-counting station." (천 수석부대표는 “올림픽공원 개표소에 있는 투표지에 대한 재검표를 준비하기 위해 국조특위 활동 기간을 연장하기로 했다”고 설명했다.)

Kim said, "We agreed that additional investigation is necessary, not only for the recount but also because various allegations surrounding the Election Commission continue to be raised," and added, "We requested that if the special counsel recommendation process proceeds quickly, the option of linking it to the recount be actively considered." (김 수석부대표는 “재검표 사유뿐 아니라 선관위를 둘러싼 여러 의혹이 계속 제기되고 있어 추가 조사가 필요하다는 데 동의했다”며 “특검 추천 절차가 신속하게 진행될 경우 재검표와 연계하는 방안도 적극적으로 검토해 달라고 요청했다”고 말했다.)

Considering the Judiciary Committee's review of the special counsel bill, the ruling and opposition parties asked the National Assembly Speaker to convene the plenary session at 3 PM instead of the originally scheduled 2 PM. Cheon reported, "I understand the Speaker will proceed with the plenary session according to that schedule." <<>> (여야는 법사위의 특검법 심사를 고려해 이날 오후 2시로 예정됐던 국회 본회의를 오후 3시에 개의해 달라고 국회의장에게 요청했다. 천 수석부대표는 “의장도 해당 일정에 따라 본회의를 진행할 것으로 알고 있다”고 전했다.)
